meta.title: {brand} · Tell us your problem and get a hand
meta.description: Ask for or offer help with IT, websites, design, online paperwork, video-call lessons and much more. In-app chat, no need to share your phone number.

home.heroSubtitle: Tell us your problem and someone who knows will lend a hand: by video call, screen sharing or however you prefer.
home.searchWhatPlaceholder: E.g. set up Wi-Fi, build a website…
home.trust: In-app chat without sharing your phone number, and reviews only from services done here.
home.askText: Say what you need and get messages from people ready to help, wherever they are.
home.askStep1: Post your request in two minutes
home.offerText: Share what you can do, pick your hours and help from wherever you like.
home.offerStep1: Create a listing for your service
home.offerStep2: Reply to people who message you
home.offerStep3: Agree on the details and help
home.how1Text: Explain what you need or what you offer.
home.how2Text: Ask questions in the in-app chat without sharing your phone number.
home.how3Text: Receive a clear proposal with price, date and conditions.
home.how4Text: Most help happens by video call or remote assistance, with no travel needed.
home.how5Text: When everything is fine, you confirm the service was completed.
home.how6Text: Both people review each other and help the community choose better.
home.safety1Text: Talk without sharing your phone or email, and block or report anyone who breaks the rules.
home.safety2Text: Some people verify their identity. We explain what each badge means.
home.safety3Text: Only people who took part in a service booked here can leave a review.
home.safety4Text: A team reviews claims and is there when you need it.
home.safety5Text: You can report any listing, message or profile in two taps.
home.safety6Text: We only show the town or an approximate distance, never your address.
home.problemPlaceholder: E.g. my computer is super slow and weird ads keep popping up
home.problemHint: One sentence is enough. Nobody will judge you for not knowing.
home.availableText: People who can lend you a hand today.
home.requestsText: Good at this? Maybe you can help someone today.
home.step1Text: Describe your problem in your own words, no jargon.
home.step2Text: People who know will message you. Chat here without sharing your number.
home.step3Text: Fix it by video call or screen share. And say thanks if you like.
home.helperCtaTitle: Are you the one who fixes things?
home.helperCtaText: If your family calls you when the Wi-Fi fails, people here need you.

pages.howIntro: {brand} connects people who need a hand with tech, online paperwork or a lesson with people who know how. Here’s how it works, step by step.
pages.howOffer1: Create your account and complete your profile.
pages.howOffer2: Post a listing with what you can do, how (online or in person) and your price.
pages.howOffer3: Reply in the chat to whoever messages you and agree on the details.
pages.howOffer4: Reply in the chat and send clear proposals.
pages.howOffer5: Provide the service. For now, you agree on payment between yourselves.
pages.howPaymentsText: For now {brand} does not handle payments: the two of you agree on them. We recommend writing down the price in the chat before starting and never paying upfront to someone you don’t know.
pages.safetyIntro: We want asking for and offering help to feel as safe as asking a trusted neighbour.
pages.safetyTip4: Be wary of anyone asking you to pay upfront.
pages.safetyTip5: For dealings with public bodies, always use official representation. Nobody may use your keys.
pages.safetyTip6: If something looks wrong, report it: we review it and explain our decision.
pages.emergency: If there is immediate danger, call 112.

publish.title: Post a listing
publish.saveError: We couldn’t save the draft. We’ll try again.
publish.q1: Do you need help or want to offer it?

publish.kindOfferHelp: Present a service you know how to provide.
publish.q2: What kind of help is it?
publish.q3: Describe it in your own words

publish.descriptionHelp: Explain what needs doing, how long it may take and any important detail.
publish.tagsHelp: Comma-separated words so people can find you.

publish.tip2: Say whether materials or tools are needed.
publish.tip3: Don’t include phone numbers, emails or links: you can talk in the chat.

publish.municipalityHelp: We only show the town, never your address.
publish.photosHelp: Up to {max} JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photos of up to 10 MB. We remove location and other hidden data from each photo.
publish.photosWarning: Don’t upload photos of documents (ID, prescriptions, reports), of people without their consent or of children.
publish.photosNotAllowed: Photos are not allowed in this category to protect children and vulnerable people.
publish.invalidImage: the file is not a valid image
publish.tooMany: you’ve reached the maximum number of photos
publish.q8: This is how your listing will look
